## Notes

- Abstract Motorisation Point Loss Chart (SPI 32.59, Abstract Logistics; the chart sheet heads it 58.5): in each month's first naval convoy stage, the percentage of every motorisation point on the map lost for the previous month — Commonwealth left of the chart's stroke, Axis right. Months printed as a dash (before October 1940, after January 1943) are not rows
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 107, printed sideways) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p13): 0 of 56 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
